y24_added.note: 2025/2026 already exclude a small fraction of members for the identical reason (36/5881=0.6% for 2025; 25/4755=0.5% for 2026), because stats[*].z was built once from 2025/2026 members' zips only. 2024's excluded fraction (687/6512=10.5%) is larger only because 2024 is a different population, not because of any data-quality problem with those zips -- no county is guessed for an unresolvable zip, consistent with existing methodology.
